items.reason: “吩咐”带兼语结构“人捉拿谁”，询问捉拿的对象；选项中的“从犹大来的”等是普通定语。上下文明确“王”的所指，无未解决的指代。
主句询问“谁咒诅了……”，“被偷的”是修饰“银子”的单层被动定语。选项简明，无未解决的指代。
前句“说”带内容“坐在这里也必死”，后句以“之后”连接并询问同一群人的决定，没有切换到另一人的言语或感知。“他们”明确回指四个人，“这里”由城门口的语境确定；选项结构直接。
A single main question asks for the complement of “full of,” with no embedded clause. “The road” is uniquely identifiable from the pursuit account; no unresolved referent.

“Want the Levite to ask God” nests consultation inside desire, requiring readers to track Dan's people as those wanting, the Levite as intermediary, and God as the one consulted. No pronoun is unresolved, but the two-layer, three-role structure creates avoidable decoding burden.
“被那附着邪灵的人制服以后”是前置被动时间结构，其中施事“人”又受“附着邪灵的”修饰，直到后面的“谁”才出现所问的参与者。无未解决的指代，但这种嵌套延迟了主问句，选项不能消除该负担。
“带他回来的”作为关系性定语修饰宣告者“先知”，其后又嵌入“谁的尸首必不得入他列祖的坟墓”这一古雅否定预告。前一个“他”指被带回者，后一个“他”需随“谁”另行解析，形成重复代词的指代切换；选项B、C还重复这些指代表达。

The main question contains one reported-content clause: the spies “say” that objects “were in one of the houses.” This is ordinary single-level reporting; “the spies” is clear in context, and no referent remains unresolved.

The causal question contains one belief complement, “Yahweh would be good to him,” under “Micah think.” This is a normal single reported belief; “him” clearly refers to Micah, with no unresolved referent.
A single main clause asks how the killing occurs; “Shechem's” is a simple possessive modifier of “leaders.” There is no embedded clause or unresolved pronoun, and the wording is grammatically direct.
